imageAlt: Model Merging Autoresearch: an LLM agent reads, reasons, writes merging code, and iterates using repository, paper, figure, candidate, evaluation, budget, submission, and optional human-review tools. LoRA adapters are merged and evaluated on SNLI, MNLI, and SciTail, with scores feeding back to the agent.
IR3DE-AXL routing diagram on a white background: a user prompt passes through the IR3DE router to a code expert among general-chat, code, and math models, which returns a Python response
FedDrive diagram showing a global server learning from driving clients in different road and weather domains
Fed3R workflow showing clients extracting pre-trained features, sharing statistics with a server, and building closed-form classifiers
The black dragon emblem used in Eros Fanì’s personal website branding

First Person Action Recognition schematic: video passes through ResNet-34 with object-centric attention and ConvLSTM to an action classifier. An auxiliary branch learns 14-by-14 grayscale motion maps during training. Separate panels show static/dynamic discrimination and representation-flow variants.

Speaker Accent Recognition schematic: 329 recordings represented by 12 MFCC features, preprocessing experiments, six classifier families, stratified splitting, five-fold grid search, and evaluation across six dataset accent groups

BioPy schematic showing separate RNA and chromatin-image encoders and decoders connected through a shared latent space, with adversarial training, MK-MMD, HAFN, and SAFN alignment variants and the A549, CD4+, and GDC datasets
